observations: Handshake coalescing rejects spans above MAX_HANDSHAKE_SIZE=0xffff, and deframer buffer growth is capped at 0xffff while joining handshake messages.
The pinned server builder uses NeverProducesTickets; this adapter explicitly disables session storage, TLS1.3 tickets and early data.
with_single_cert validates supported key DER and checks end-entity certificate/public-key matching.
The adapter uses stock WebPkiClientVerifier Required policy with the explicit ring provider; no custom verifier is provided.
limits: These are specific parser/configuration bounds and source observations; no whole-process RSS or asynchronous runtime preemption claim.
